description: This PHP source file defines the AWS FSx client class, providing method signatures for interacting with the Amazon FSx service. It extends the AwsClient class and uses PHPDoc annotations to document available methods for managing FSx resources such as file systems, backups, snapshots, and related entities.

classes.name: FSxClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the Amazon FSx service API, extending the base AwsClient class, with methods for managing FSx resources.

methods.name: associateFileSystemAliases
methods.description: Associates file system aliases with the specified file system.

methods.name: createBackup
methods.description: Creates a backup of an Amazon FSx file system.

methods.name: createFileCache
methods.description: Creates a new Amazon FSx file cache resource.

methods.name: createFileSystem
methods.description: Creates a new Amazon FSx file system.

methods.name: createFileSystemFromBackup
methods.description: Creates a new file system from an existing backup.

methods.name: createSnapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of a file system.

methods.name: deleteFileSystem
methods.description: Deletes an Amazon FSx file system.

methods.name: describeBackups
methods.description: Returns the description of backups in the account.

methods.name: describeFileSystemAliases
methods.description: Returns information about the specified file system aliases.

methods.name: describeStorageVirtualMachines
methods.description: Returns descriptions of storage virtual machines.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags for the specified resource.

methods.name: releaseFileSystemNfsV3Locks
methods.description: Releases NFSv3 locks on the file system.

methods.name: restoreVolumeFromSnapshot
methods.description: Restores a volume from a snapshot.

methods.name: startMisconfiguredStateRecovery
methods.description: Starts recovery from a misconfigured state.
